name: a missing tsc passes the page script's check (P1061)
find:
if found is None:
        return TSC_REFUSAL

name: a tsc that is not 7.0 passes the page script's check (P1061)
a committed page_script.js that is not tsc's output passes (P1061)
a tsc that says errors passes, or is not quoted (P1061)
a change of tsconfig.json runs no check of the page script (P1061)
--full does not check the page script (P1061)
find: return full or changed is None or named
replace: return changed is None or named

name: a tree from before P1061 is compiled, and the gate fails a tree with no TypeScript (P1061)
a branch that deleted page_script.ts turns the check off (the review of #1606)
find: return named and any((tree / name).is_file() for name in SCRIPT_SOURCES[1:])

name: the compile runs a bare tsc, not the one whose version was read (the review of #1606)
the gate runs the suite on a page script that drifted (P1061)
find: drift = compiles and script_drift(scratch, which("tsc"), run)
